rule: Two callbacks for one order add its months once
setup:
INSERT INTO workspace VALUES ('w1',0);
INSERT INTO "order"(id,"workspaceId") VALUES ('o1','w1')
notes: SQL transliteration of the webhook handler; covers bounded SQL orders only, not HTTP or Stripe.

statements: WITH c AS (UPDATE "order" SET "completedAt"=now() WHERE id='o1' AND "completedAt" IS NULL RETURNING id) UPDATE workspace SET "remainingMonths"="remainingMonths"+1 WHERE id='w1' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM c)

WITH c AS (UPDATE "order" SET "completedAt"=now() WHERE id='o1' AND "completedAt" IS NULL RETURNING id) UPDATE workspace SET "remainingMonths"="remainingMonths"+1 WHERE id='w1' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM c)
